verses.english: This was said by the Buddha, the Perfected One: that is what I heard.

verses.pali: “Nayidaṁ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṁ vussati janakuhanatthaṁ, na janalapanatthaṁ, na lābhasakkārasilokānisaṁsatthaṁ, na ‘iti maṁ jano jānātū’ti.
verses.english: “Mendicants, this spiritual life is not lived for the sake of fawning or flattering people, nor for the benefit of possessions, honor, or popularity, nor thinking, ‘So let people know about me!’

verses.pali: Atha kho idaṁ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṁ vussati saṁvaratthañceva pahānatthañcā”ti.
verses.english: This spiritual life is lived for the sake of restraint and giving up.”
but for the sake of restraint and giving up,
and because its objective is extinguishment.
This is the path followed by the great souls,
as it was taught by the Buddha

verses.pali: Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.
verses.english: This too is a matter that was spoken by the Blessed One: that is what I heard.
